stem.text: Which graph represents the number of unpaired electrons in the atoms of six elements in Period 3 of the Periodic Table?

A.alt: Graph of number of unpaired electrons against proton number 13 to 18: a straight line rising from 13 to 18.

B.alt: Graph of number of unpaired electrons against proton number 13 to 18: a straight line falling from 13 to zero at 18.

C.alt: Graph of number of unpaired electrons against proton number 13 to 18: a line rising from 13 to 15, then horizontal to 18.

D.alt: Graph of number of unpaired electrons against proton number 13 to 18: a line rising from 13 to a peak at 15, then falling to zero at 18.
